title: saussurea kai-montana var. minor
intro: Saussurea kai-montana var. minor, commonly known as Himalayan saussurea, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae) that grows in the Himalayan regions. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, colds, and digestive issues, due to its reported health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Saussurea kai-montana var. minor include sesquiterpenes, triterpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
